parameters.description:
Measure EBU R128 loudness and optionally create a normalized PCM artifact.

Integrated loudness inside ``[acceptable_min_lufs, acceptable_max_lufs]``, widened
by ``loudness_tolerance_lu`` on both sides, is not flagged. The default range runs
from the EBU R128 broadcast target (-23 LUFS) to the -14 LUFS normalization level
of the loudest common streaming platforms, with R128's +/-1 LU tolerance; set the
range to -23..-23 for strict broadcast delivery (-23 +/- 1). ``target_lufs`` is the
level that ``normalize`` produces.

parameters.description:
Search repeated windows frame by frame and extend each match to its real extent.

Repeats lasting at least 1.5 windows are located wherever they start. Frames
match when the thumbnail differs little on average (``max_spatial_difference``)
and nowhere by much (``max_local_difference``, so a changed clock digit or a
subject elsewhere in a static scene is not a match), and when the picture
changes the same way; windows of static picture are never reported.

parameters.description:

issue intervals already annotated on the file (invalid frames, duplicates).

parameters.description:
Define image-quality thresholds in 8-bit luminance, pixels and noise measures.

Sixteen-bit samples are rescaled to 8-bit levels before measuring.
Defaults come from generated scenes saved as PNG and JPEG.
``min_sharpness`` bounds the contrast-invariant edge sharpness: clean,
hazy, snowy, minimal and low-contrast scenes measured at least 1.29, and
the same scenes under Gaussian blur of sigma 1.5 or more at most 0.95.
``min_highlight`` bounds
the 99.9th luminance percentile: clean scenes reached at least 144 and
halved exposures at most 110. ``max_impulse_fraction`` sits between clean
scenes (at most 0.00003) and 1% salt-and-pepper noise (at least 0.0068).
``blur_threshold`` is the earlier absolute Laplacian variance, which
falls with contrast; it is off unless set.
parameters.title: ImageQualityParams

parameters.description:
Control statistical, sparse-coverage and unit-suspicion file-level policy.

``max_outlier_ratio`` defaults to 0.04%, near the geometric middle of
the worst clean generated scan (0.029%, a sparse 32-ring street) and the
least flagged generated scan with 0.5% embedded outliers (0.060%, a
2.6-million-point drive of 24 frames). Sampled files are judged by the
lower end of the 95% interval, so sampling error alone cannot raise an
issue.
